_WARNING: SHADOW-ONLY LIMITS. NOT PRODUCTION VALUES. NOT A RECOMMENDATION.
_purpose: Lets SHADOW replays run and produce evidence before any human has chosen real numbers. NOT production values. NOT a recommendation. Production values are open decision D-1 and remain the account owner's to make.
_revised: revision 2, 2026-08-09: the backtest showed three revision-1 values made trend_breakout@1.0.0 unrunnable rather than merely conservative. max_open_positions 1 -> 4 (at 1 the edge is not distinguishable from zero: 181 trades in 11.6y, t=1.13). max_open_portfolio_risk_fraction 0.01 -> 0.02 (1% capped the book at 2 positions, contradicting the line above). max_consecutive_losses 6 -> 12 (10-17 observed; at 6 the kill switch trips several times a year). See docs/STRATEGY_V1.md section 11.3.

_derivation.max_account_risk_fraction: 0.005 = 0.5% of allocated equity. On $6,474 that is ~$32/trade, so 20 consecutive losses cost ~10% of the account.
_derivation.max_daily_loss_fraction: 0.02 = 4 max-risk trades. Deliberately tight: the recorded history has an average loss of $433, which is 6.7% of the current account.
_derivation.max_drawdown_fraction: 0.15 = halt well before the recorded history's realized drawdown.
_derivation.max_consecutive_losses: 12 — observed max is 10-17 across the sample. A 1.5:1 system at 40% hits long streaks routinely.
_derivation.max_open_positions: 4 — below 3 the strategy has no measurable edge; benefit plateaus around 5.
